# Quad Education Group

> > Quad Education Group provides comprehensive college admissions consulting, test prep guidance, and application resources for high school students pursuing elite universities.

Founded by education expert Mary Banks, Quad Education Group offers strategic guidance on navigating the competitive college admissions process, from standardized testing (SAT/ACT) to supplemental essays for top-tier institutions. The site features interactive assessment tools, detailed school-specific application guides, and curated resources for extracurricular planning.

## Key Topics

- College Admissions Strategy
- Supplemental Essay Writing
- SAT and ACT Test Preparation
- Ivy League and Elite Universities
- Demonstrated Interest
- Extracurricular Activities
- College Application Essays
- Admissions Requirements
- School Rankings and Selection
- High School Planning
- Summer Programs
- Scholarship Opportunities
- Co-op Programs
- Standardized Testing Strategies
- Application Timeline Management

## Interactive Admissions Tools

- [Will I Get Into Williams College? Quiz [Assess Your Chances]](https://www.quadeducationgroup.com/tools/will-i-get-into-williams-college-quiz): Interactive quiz assessing Williams College admission chances with SAT/ACT
- [Will I Get Into Carnegie Mellon University? Quiz [Assess Your Chances]](https://www.quadeducationgroup.com/tools/will-i-get-into-carnegie-mellon-quiz): CMU admission chances assessment quiz with acceptance predictor
- [Quiz: What Should I Study in College?](https://www.quadeducationgroup.com/tools/what-should-i-study-in-college): Interactive quiz matching interests to ideal college majors
- [Compare SAT Scores by State - Quad Education](https://www.quadeducationgroup.com/sat-scores-by-state): State-by-state SAT score comparison with national averages
